isolates: check 11, the duplicate bound-tuple check (rev5 l.64-66, 24a), iterating pinnedEntries instead of sources
why: Two unpinned entries identical across url, snippet_sha256, content_kind and retrieved_at. The baseline iterates every source and halts on the duplicate; the f24 build iterates the pinned entries only, sees one entry, and does not. No rev 7 vector carries a duplicated UNPINNED tuple, which is why the two builds are indistinguishable on the fixture set.
